name: Pehak
ingredients: Fermented soybean paste (locally known as Axone or Chura)
instructions: 1. Roast the dried red chilies over an open flame until charred for a smoky flavor.
2. In a mortar and pestle, grind the roasted red chilies into a coarse paste.
3. Add the fermented soybean paste (Axone) to the mortar.
4. Add salt and a splash of water if needed to adjust the consistency.
5. Pound all ingredients together until well combined into a thick, rustic chutney texture.
description: Pehak is a pungent, spicy, and traditional chutney native to Arunachal Pradesh. It is a staple accompaniment in many tribal households, valued for its unique umami profile derived from fermented soybean paste. It reflects the region's reliance on fermentation as a method of preservation and flavor enhancement.
